scenes.text: Scientists found there's a sweet spot of fear that's the most fun.
Researchers from Aarhus University sent one hundred and ten people through a haunted house in Denmark.
Everyone wore heart rate monitors and rated each scare.
Too little fear was boring, and too much fear stopped being fun.
Enjoyment peaked right in the middle, at a just-right level of scared.
Their heart rates showed the same up-then-down pattern.
Are you a horror fan, or a scaredy cat?

title: Science found the perfect amount of fear 😱
caption: In a study of 110 haunted-house visitors in Denmark, enjoyment peaked at a medium level of fear, not too little, not too much. Heart rates showed the same inverted-U pattern. 😱
